mapper.select: SELECT c.*, t.name as teacher_name, s.name as semester_name FROM course c LEFT JOIN teacher t ON c.teacher_id = t.id LEFT JOIN semester s ON c.semester_id = s.id WHERE c.id = #{id}

SELECT c.*, t.name as teacher_name, s.name as semester_name FROM course c JOIN course_selection cs ON c.id = cs.course_id LEFT JOIN teacher t ON c.teacher_id = t.id LEFT JOIN semester s ON c.semester_id = s.id WHERE cs.student_id = #{studentId} AND cs.status = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE course SET current_students = current_students + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND current_students < max_students
UPDATE course SET current_students = current_students - 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND current_students > 0
mapper.select:
SELECT c.*, t.name as teacher_name, s.name as semester_name FROM course c LEFT JOIN teacher t ON c.teacher_id = t.id LEFT JOIN semester s ON c.semester_id = s.id WHERE c.teacher_id = #{teacherId}
AND c.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{courseName}, '%')
AND c.schedule LIKE CONCAT('%', #{schedule}, '%')
ORDER BY c.id DESC

SELECT s.id AS studentId, s.student_no AS studentNo, s.name AS studentName, s.major, s.class_name AS className, cs.score FROM course_selection cs JOIN student s ON cs.student_id = s.id WHERE cs.course_id = #{courseId} AND cs.status = 0 ORDER BY s.student_no
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO course (course_code, name, credit, max_students, current_students, teacher_id, semester_id, schedule, status) VALUES (#{courseCode}, #{name}, #{credit}, #{maxStudents}, #{currentStudents}, #{teacherId}, #{semesterId}, #{schedule}, #{status})
